label: Child sex
harmonisation_rule: Male=1, female=0; DHS b4 and MICS BH3 recoded to a common indicator, MICS non-response set missing.

label: Birth order
harmonisation_rule: Integer order. MICS truncates at 4 or more, coarsening the parity contrast for the 11 MICS-only countries.

label: Preceding birth interval
harmonisation_rule: Months since the preceding birth; undefined for first births, which are modelled as their own state rather than missing. MICS6/7 ordinal categories mapped to category midpoints.

label: Maternal age at birth
harmonisation_rule: Age at interview minus years since the birth, clamped to 10-55. Refers to the birth, but is reconstructed from an interview-reported age.

label: Maternal education
harmonisation_rule: Highest level attended (none/primary/secondary/higher); post-secondary sub-categories collapsed to higher. Recorded at interview: schooling completed after the index birth is counted, so this is a proxy for education at the birth.

label: Current marital status
harmonisation_rule: Married or cohabiting=1. Explicitly a *current* status; union formation and dissolution after the birth are not distinguishable.

label: Household wealth quintile
harmonisation_rule: Survey-specific asset-index quintile, so quintiles are relative within each survey and measured at interview, not at the birth.

label: Urban residence
harmonisation_rule: Urban=1, rural=0, at the interview household. Migration between the birth and the interview is not observed.

label: Household size
harmonisation_rule: Present in the DHS extract but absent from the harmonised analysis file, so it is NOT a model feature and is listed here only for completeness.
